item.title: US open to letting India access Venezuelan oil under new framework
item.description: The US has signalled it may allow India to resume buying Venezuelan oil under a new framework, with Washington overseeing marketing and revenue flows. The move hints at eased restrictions for a key pre-sanctions buyer, while maintaining tight US control.

item.title: Only SC can rein in ED after I-PAC raids spark political row in Bengal: Sibal
item.description: Senior advocate and Independent Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal said India’s federal structure is “at the mercy” of the ED, asserting that only the Supreme Court can check what he termed the agency’s growing overreach.

item.title: Reliance open to Venezuelan oil purchases if sales to non-US buyers are cleared
item.description: Reliance Industries Ltd, which operates the world’s largest refining complex, has said it would consider buying Venezuelan crude if sales are permitted to non-US buyers, signalling potential interest from Indian refiners should restrictions ease.

item.title: Proposal to lift Chinese contract curbs draws sharp Congress criticism
item.description: The Centre is considering scrapping the 2020 curbs on Chinese firms bidding for government contracts to revive commercial ties as border tensions ease, sources say. The move has sparked sharp Congress criticism, invoking the Galwan Valley sacrifices.
